candidates.trace: The generated investigation window computes projected wait_minutes, calls settlement rest for a settlement wait of at least 60 minutes or camp rest otherwise, and after successful completion adds that requested amount to generated_investigation_wait_minutes and emits the same wait_minutes in the event. It does not measure before/after time in this function. The settlement reducer discards rest_for_minutes actual returned duration and its injury/disease settlement may clip the request before writing character_time. Camp rest can clip at a narrative boundary and disease or injury boundaries; it writes each member’s settled elapsed to that member’s own clock and returns only unit, while the simulator shelter wrapper returns shelter rather than elapsed. Thus, conditional on an admitted successful invocation with owner elapsed E less than requested R and no intervening error, the metric and event add/display R while the owner clock advances E. This does not establish such a state is reachable, a transaction commits, or that the metric promises elapsed rather than requested time. Camp rest is permitted at a settlement; the short-wait choice alone is not a venue defect.
